scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic and infinite-family; finite scripts corroborate n<=11 and n<=19 respectively. Independent scholarly audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Covers only maximum distance-two packings of the three-row Cartesian cylinder for n>=5 and local edge slides; does not classify other widths or nonoptimal packings. General three-color winding invariance is previously known. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Winding-number phase transition in maximum distance-two packings of triangular cylinders
